products.name: Electrical Solutions and Components
products.description: Design and manufacture of electrical power charging and data systems, lighting solutions, and electrical components and assemblies for medical, transportation, industrial, and appliance markets, produced in U.S. and Mexico facilities.

products.name: Industrial Lifting and Motion Products
products.description: Manufacture of screw jacks, linear actuators, and related linear motion and lifting systems for industrial applications, serving diverse end markets including energy, metals, and material handling.

products.name: Combustion Equipment for Utilities and Industry
products.description: Production and global supply of burners, igniters, dampers, and controls for combustion processes in electric utility and industrial applications, manufactured in Mexico and distributed worldwide.

products.name: Automotive Dealership and Valet Repair Services
products.description: Operation of automotive dealerships selling new and used vehicles, parts, and services, as well as provision of valet automotive repair services, primarily in the Washington, D.C. area.

products.name: Restaurant and Hospitality Services
products.description: Ownership and operation of restaurants and entertainment venues, offering dining and event experiences in the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area, with both owned and licensed locations.

products.name: Custom Framing Services
products.description: Direct-to-consumer custom framing services for artwork and personal objects, offered through online, app, and retail channels, with centralized manufacturing and delivery or in-store pickup.

products.name: Online Art Marketplace and Art Fairs
products.description: Online platform and in-person events for artists to exhibit and sell original artwork directly to consumers, including virtual reality and global art fairs.

products.name: Print-on-Demand Art and Design Products
products.description: Online marketplace for artists and designers to sell original art and designs printed on a variety of made-to-order consumer products, primarily in home décor, fulfilled by third-party partners.

products.name: Digital Marketing and Advertising Services
products.description: Provision of managed digital advertising, media, creative, and data services for brands, leveraging digital platforms and analytics to optimize marketing ROI.

products.name: Ecommerce Analytics Software
products.description: AI-powered ecommerce analytics platform providing customer, product, and sales data analysis and insights for marketers, delivered as a software service.

products.name: Digital Media Publishing
products.description: Online publication of news, analysis, and podcasts on politics, culture, and global affairs, including subscription-based and advertising-supported content, delivered via web and mobile platforms.

products.name: Local News Podcasts and Newsletters
products.description: Production and distribution of daily local news podcasts, email newsletters, and social media content covering local events and issues in multiple U.S. cities.

products.name: Podcast Monetization Platform
products.description: Software-as-a-service platform enabling podcasters and media companies to monetize premium audio content through paid subscriptions, memberships, and audiobooks, integrated with mainstream podcast players.

products.name: Insurance and Reinsurance Services
products.description: Provides primary insurance and reinsurance for property, casualty, life, accident, health, and specialty risks worldwide through subsidiaries such as GEICO, Berkshire Hathaway Primary Group, and Berkshire Hathaway Reinsurance Group. Services are delivered via direct sales, agents, brokers, and digital platforms, and are subject to extensive regulatory oversight.

products.name: Freight Rail Transportation
products.description: Operates one of the largest freight rail transportation systems in North America through BNSF Railway, transporting consumer, industrial, agricultural, energy products, and coal. Services are provided via a regulated, asset-intensive rail network covering major U.S. regions and ports.

products.name: Utility and Energy Generation, Transmission, and Distribution
products.description: Provides regulated electric and natural gas utility services, electricity transmission and distribution, and operates independent power projects (mainly renewable) in the U.S., U.K., and Canada. Services are delivered through owned infrastructure, including power plants, pipelines, and distribution networks, and are subject to comprehensive regulation.

products.name: Natural Gas Pipeline Transportation and Storage
products.description: Operates interstate natural gas pipelines and storage facilities in the U.S. through subsidiaries such as BHE GT&S, Northern Natural Gas, and Kern River, providing transportation and storage services to utilities and other customers. Services require regulated, capital-intensive infrastructure.

products.name: Residential Real Estate Brokerage and Related Services
products.description: Offers residential real estate brokerage, mortgage origination, title and closing, insurance, home warranties, and relocation services through HomeServices of America and its franchise network. Services are delivered via a large agent network and franchisees under multiple brand names.

products.name: Aerospace and Power Generation Components and Materials
products.description: Manufactures complex metal components, investment castings, forgings, fasteners, alloys, and aerostructures for aerospace, power generation, and industrial markets through Precision Castparts. Products are produced using advanced manufacturing processes and supplied to OEMs and other industrial customers.

products.name: Specialty Chemicals and Performance Materials
products.description: Produces lubricant additives, engineered polymers, performance coatings, and specialty chemicals for transportation, industrial, and consumer markets through Lubrizol and OxyChem. Products are manufactured in global facilities and supplied to OEMs and industrial customers.

products.name: Metal Cutting Tools and Industrial Components
products.description: Manufactures and distributes precision carbide metal cutting tools, inserts, and tool holders for industrial, automotive, aerospace, and machinery markets through IMC International Metalworking Companies. Products are engineered and distributed globally.

products.name: Industrial, Building, and Consumer Products Manufacturing
products.description: Manufactures a wide range of products including foodservice equipment, water treatment systems, transportation products, electrical wire, plumbing and HVAC components, construction fasteners, railcars, medical devices, agricultural systems, drag reduction agents, structural steel, rodenticides, and more through Marmon, CTB, LSPI, W&W|AFCO, Bell Laboratories, and others. Products are produced in global facilities and supplied to industrial, commercial, and consumer markets.

products.name: Prefabricated and Site-Built Homes and Home Financing
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells off-site (factory-built) and site-built homes, including modular and manufactured homes, and provides home financing and related services through Clayton Homes. Homes are sold via company-owned and independent centers, with integrated supply and financing operations.

products.name: Flooring, Insulation, Roofing, and Building Materials
products.description: Manufactures and distributes carpet, hard surface flooring, insulation, roofing, fiberglass, engineered components, paint, bricks, and masonry products through Shaw, Johns Manville, MiTek, Benjamin Moore, Acme, and others. Products are produced in integrated facilities and distributed to retailers, contractors, and end-users.

products.name: Recreational Vehicles, Apparel, Footwear, Batteries, Toys, Jewelry, and Other Consumer Products
products.description: Manufactures and distributes recreational vehicles, trailers, boats, apparel, footwear, batteries, toys, jewelry, kitchenware, party supplies, and other consumer goods through subsidiaries such as Forest River, Fruit of the Loom, Brooks, Duracell, Jazwares, Richline, Pampered Chef, and others. Products are sold via retail, wholesale, and direct-to-consumer channels.

products.name: Private Aviation Services and Aircraft Training
products.description: Provides shared aircraft ownership, jet card, and aircraft management services through NetJets, and professional aviation training and flight simulation products through FlightSafety. Services are delivered via owned aircraft fleets, simulators, and training centers globally.

products.name: Electronic Components Distribution
products.description: Distributes passive, interconnect, electromechanical, discrete, and semiconductor components to OEMs and manufacturers through TTI, Inc. Services are provided via a global network of sales offices and distribution centers.

products.name: Wholesale Distribution Services (Retail, Restaurant, Beverage)
products.description: Provides wholesale distribution of groceries, foodservice, and beverages to convenience stores, restaurants, and retailers nationwide through McLane Company. Services are delivered via a network of distribution centers and logistics operations.

products.name: Automotive Retailing and Services
products.description: Operates automotive dealerships selling new and used vehicles, maintenance and repair services, and related products through Berkshire Hathaway Automotive. Services are delivered via franchised dealerships and collision centers in major U.S. markets.

products.name: Travel Centers, Fuel Retailing, and Related Services
products.description: Operates travel centers and fuel retail locations under the Pilot and Flying J brands, providing fuel, food, merchandise, and amenities to travelers and truck drivers. Also conducts wholesale fuel and water disposal businesses.

products.name: Home Furnishings Retailing
products.description: Sells furniture, bedding, appliances, electronics, and home accessories through retail chains such as Nebraska Furniture Mart, R.C. Willey, Jordan’s, and Star. Products are sold via large-format stores and supported by distribution centers.

products.name: Diversity Recruitment Advertising and Job Board Services
products.description: Online recruitment advertising and job board services focused on connecting employers with diverse talent pools through affinity groups and partnerships with minority organizations. Delivered via proprietary digital platforms and targeted marketing technology.

products.name: Career Fairs (Virtual and In-Person)
products.description: Production and hosting of face-to-face and virtual career fairs, including Professional Diversity Career Fairs and specialized events for engineering, technology, and security clearance positions. Delivered both online and at physical venues, leveraging partnerships with major organizations.

products.name: Contingent Placement and Hiring Solutions
products.description: Contingent hiring and placement services for employers, charging a fee based on successful candidate hires. Delivered through direct sourcing and matching of candidates from the company’s network.

products.name: Professional Networking Memberships for Women
products.description: Paid membership-based professional networking services for women, offering access to networking events, professional development resources, promotional tools, and mentorship. Delivered via online platforms and in-person/virtual events under the NAPW and IAW brands.

products.name: Professional Development and Coaching Services
products.description: Professional development offerings including webinars, seminars, certification courses, coaching, and leadership labs for members. Delivered digitally and through live events, often as part of upgraded membership packages.

products.name: Remote Software Developer Marketplace Services
products.description: Marketplace services connecting companies with vetted, remote software developers for custom software solutions. Delivered via an online platform operated by RemoteMore USA, facilitating global remote hiring.

products.name: Web3.0, Digital Asset, and RWA Platform Initiatives (in development)
products.description: Exploratory initiatives in blockchain-based technologies, digital assets, and real-world asset tokenization, including entertainment-related copyright assets. Currently in early development with no material revenue generated.

products.name: Hot-Mix Asphalt Plants and Related Equipment
products.description: Manufacture and sale of hot-mix asphalt plants and related components such as storage silos, filtration systems, cold feed bins, and batch plants. These are large, physical manufacturing products used in the production of asphalt paving materials, primarily for highway construction.

products.name: Combustion Systems and Industrial Incinerators
products.description: Design, manufacture, and sale of combustion systems and industrial incinerators, including large burners for transforming various fuels into usable energy and systems for rotary dryers, kilns, and fuel heaters. These are engineered, physical products for industrial energy and environmental control applications.

products.name: Fluid Heat Transfer Systems and Specialty Storage Tanks
products.description: Manufacture and sale of thermal fluid heat transfer systems and specialty storage tanks, used for industrial heating and storage of viscous materials. These systems are physical products similar to boilers but use high temperature oil, serving industrial and petrochemical applications.

products.name: Asphalt Pavers
products.description: Manufacture and sale of highway-class asphalt pavers under the Blaw-Knox brand, used for laying asphalt in road construction. These are large, physical machines designed for reliability and high-quality pavement surfaces.

products.name: Natural Gas Production and Sales
products.description: Extraction and sale of natural gas from company-operated wells across the Appalachian and Central regions, utilizing physical drilling, well operation, and regulated infrastructure to deliver product to market.

products.name: Natural Gas Liquids (NGLs) Production and Sales
products.description: Extraction and sale of natural gas liquids (NGLs) from company-operated wells, involving physical production, separation, and delivery through regulated infrastructure to customers.

products.name: Crude Oil Production and Sales
products.description: Extraction and sale of crude oil from company-operated wells, involving physical drilling, well operation, and regulated infrastructure for delivery to market.

products.name: Commodity Marketing and Producer Services
products.description: Provision of commodity marketing, risk management, logistical support, and strategic transportation management services for natural gas, NGLs, and oil, leveraging market insights and midstream infrastructure to optimize product flow and pricing for external customers.

products.name: Well Plugging and Asset Retirement Services
products.description: Provision of well plugging and asset retirement services, including a vertically integrated plugging company and dedicated plugging fund, primarily in the Appalachian region, involving in-person labor and compliance with regulatory standards for safe well retirement.

products.name: Innovative Biopharmaceutical Products
products.description: Research, development, manufacturing, marketing, and sale of innovative medicines and vaccines across multiple therapeutic areas, including internal medicine, oncology, inflammation & immunology, rare diseases, anti-infectives, and immunoglobulins. Products are delivered through regulated, large-scale manufacturing and global distribution networks.

products.name: Vaccines
products.description: Development, manufacturing, and global distribution of vaccines for various infectious diseases and age groups, including products such as Prevnar, Comirnaty, Abrysvo, FSME/IMMUN-TicoVac, Nimenrix, and Trumenba. Requires advanced biological manufacturing and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Oncology Therapeutics
products.description: Discovery, development, manufacturing, and commercialization of innovative oncology medicines, including antibody-drug conjugates, small molecules, bispecifics, and immunotherapies for a wide range of cancers. Delivered via regulated pharmaceutical channels globally.

products.name: Sterile Injectables (Branded and Generic)
products.description: Manufacture and sale of off-patent branded and generic sterile injectable medicines for hospital and clinical use, requiring specialized, highly regulated manufacturing and distribution infrastructure.

products.name: Biosimilars
products.description: Development, manufacturing, and sale of biosimilar medicines for chronic immune, inflammatory, and oncology diseases, providing lower-cost alternatives to branded biologics. Requires advanced biologics manufacturing and regulatory approval.

products.name: Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) and Contract Manufacturing Services
products.description: Supply of specialty active pharmaceutical ingredients and contract development and manufacturing services to external customers, leveraging Pfizer's manufacturing expertise and facilities.

products.name: Live Music Concert Promotion
products.description: Promotion and production of live music events and tours globally, including booking artists, securing venues, marketing, and managing event logistics. Requires significant financial capital, artist relationships, and operational expertise.

products.name: Music Venue Operations
products.description: Operation and management of music venues, including amphitheaters, arenas, theaters, clubs, and outdoor spaces, providing services such as concessions, parking, premium seating, and hospitality. Involves physical infrastructure, in-person labor, and regulated services.

products.name: Music Festival Production
products.description: Production and promotion of music festivals worldwide, including booking artists, securing festival sites, ticket sales, and providing operational services such as concessions and merchandising. Requires event production expertise and large-scale logistics.

products.name: Artist Management Services
products.description: Management of music artists' careers across all genres, including negotiating contracts, booking events, and providing strategic guidance. Delivered through dedicated artist management companies and requires industry expertise and relationships.

products.name: Primary Ticketing Services
products.description: Sale and distribution of tickets for live events on behalf of venues, promoters, and event organizers through digital platforms, mobile apps, and retail outlets. Involves proprietary technology and multi-year client contracts.

products.name: Secondary Ticketing (Ticket Resale) Services
products.description: Facilitation of ticket resale transactions between original ticket holders and new buyers, primarily through integrated digital platforms, with service fees charged to both sellers and buyers. Requires secure digital infrastructure and fraud prevention tools.

products.name: Sponsorship and Advertising Solutions
products.description: Creation and sale of sponsorship and advertising programs for corporate brands, including venue naming rights, onsite signage, digital advertising, and custom branded events. Delivered through a dedicated sales force and leveraging physical and digital assets.

products.name: Custom Branded Event Production
products.description: Development, booking, and production of custom live music events or programs tailored for corporate clients’ brands, often presented exclusively to the clients’ consumers. Involves event production expertise and artist relationships.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Loans
products.description: Direct origination and investment in commercial real estate loans, including senior mortgage loans, subordinated debt, and mezzanine loans, secured by various property types. These are structured, underwritten, and managed by the company and require significant financial capital and underwriting expertise.

products.name: Preferred Equity Investments in Real Estate
products.description: Provision of preferred equity investments in real estate entities, subordinate to mortgage loans and not collateralized by property, with covenants and rights to control the underlying property upon default. These investments are structured and managed by the company and require financial capital and legal structuring.

products.name: Commercial Mortgage-Backed Securities (CMBS) and Other CRE Securities
products.description: Investment in commercial mortgage-backed securities and other debt or equity securities related to commercial real estate, including triple net lease equity and debtor-in-possession loans. These are acquired and managed as part of the investment portfolio and require financial capital and market expertise.

products.name: Mixed Martial Arts (MMA) Events and Content (UFC)
products.description: Production and global distribution of live MMA events, original programming, and related media content, delivered via broadcast partners, pay-per-view, and direct-to-consumer streaming (UFC FIGHT PASS). Requires athlete recruitment, event production, and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Sports Entertainment Events and Content (WWE)
products.description: Production and distribution of live wrestling events, weekly television programs, and original content, delivered through broadcast partners, streaming platforms, and direct-to-consumer services (WWE Network). Involves talent development, event production, and regulated venues.

products.name: Professional Bull Riding Events and Content (PBR)
products.description: Organization and promotion of live professional bull riding events and tours, with global broadcast and streaming distribution. Involves athlete management, event production, and international circuits.

products.name: Boxing Promotion and Content (Zuffa Boxing)
products.description: Promotion and production of professional boxing events and related media content, leveraging TKO's operational, promotional, and media rights distribution expertise. Delivered via broadcast and digital channels.

products.name: Sports Media Rights Management and Distribution (IMG)
products.description: Negotiation, management, and sale of media rights for sports federations, leagues, and events; multi-channel content production and global distribution. Delivered as a service to third-party rights holders and partners.

products.name: Sports Marketing and Sponsorship Services (IMG)
products.description: Provision of brand partnerships, sponsorship sales, strategic consulting, and digital marketing services for sports organizations and events. Delivered as a service to external clients and rights holders.

products.name: Premium Experiential Hospitality and Event Services (On Location)
products.description: Provision of premium hospitality packages, ticketing, curated guest experiences, and travel management for major sports and entertainment events. Delivered to corporate clients and fans globally.

products.name: Consumer Products Licensing and Merchandise (UFC, WWE, PBR)
products.description: Licensing and direct sales of branded consumer products, including video games, apparel, equipment, trading cards, memorabilia, digital goods, and toys. Delivered through partnerships with manufacturers, retailers, and eCommerce platforms.
